notes.title: Miscellaneous tweaks v0.1.3i
notes.content:
- working on Steam Deck support
- made inventory item displays more consistent and polished
- limited how quickly you can throw grenades (to reduce framerate issues)
- Macs now only show regular screen resolutions rather than super high resolution Retina resolutions (to reduce framerate issues)
- the stress test level ("Framerate Killer") has been moved into the Bonus Options menu (and removed on the Steam Deck)
- you no longer need the keyboard or mouse to do the main things (can now pause using the left stick press)
- corpses make more impact sounds
- tipping over tree trunks now make a sound when the top hits the ground
- game no longer runs while in background

notes.title: Candles and chopping changes v0.1.3e
notes.content: [list][*][p]Red and black candles for the pentagram[/p][/*][*][p]Updated torch flames[/p][/*][*][p]Chopped idols now have shiny metal inside rather than wood[/p][/*][*][p]Chopped fruit tree leaves are green inside instead of wood[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped being able to interact with objects through walls[/p][/*][/list][p]Current issues to be investigated:[/p][list][*][p]Sometimes sword won't chop e.g. bottom of idol[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003474/b134967f8dca187531417b756f40fc222749d06f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Splatter on soldiers v0.1.3c2
notes.content:
[p]- blood and vomit can splatter on soldiers and mystery boxes (they're clean again when they respawn)
- sound reverb in main temple
- improved soldier AI
- fixed jumping issues (floating/too fast or slow)
- people hiding behind houses now talk
- can choose how loud lifeforms are in the distance[/p]

notes.title: Explosion screen shake and mouse handling v0.1.2y
notes.content:
[p]- screen and HUD shake from holy hand grenade explosions
- stopped explosions from causing damage through walls
- fixed issue where mouse movement speed depended on framerate
- can adjust mouse sensitivity, smoothness and invert (press M in game to toggle controls menu)
- inventory screen exits when item selected[/p]

notes.title: Bonus Options & Grape Stomper tweaks v0.1.2x
notes.content:
- Full gamepad support for color pickers in Bonus Options
- Head in Bonus Options looks towards selected item or mouse pointer
- Screen resolution dropdown fixed for gamepad
- Tweaked Grape Stomper level camera handling
- Fixed Grape Stomper interact notice

notes.title: Menus - gamepad and right mouse button v0.1.2v
notes.content:
- better gamepad support for menus and gameplay
- can use right mouse button for toggling menus
- City Gates level moved near top of level menu to make it more obvious
- new tree type
- made it easier to complete hiding behind houses level including with the gamepad

notes.title: Wife Recruiter Level - v0.1.2t
notes.content:
There is a new level based on Numbers 31 where you (or the other soldiers) have to kill all of the remaining boys and women who have slept with a man (the men had already been cleansed). The remaining girls need to be recruited so they can become wives for God's people when they get old enough and consent to the marriages.

also:
- soldiers now move their mouths when talking
- in the chopping quest, ears, snouts, and noses are now properly detected as a head chop
- the appearance of hills is improved
- sword can no longer chop through walls
